Temporary sweat, a scene's injury, a current outfit change or an emotional reaction does not rewrite evergreen anatomy.

Use complete canonical names in factual references and character records. Dialogue examples may address a person naturally by title, surname or first name when unambiguous. Do not copy recognizable anime characters' full names, inject unrelated Earth references or manufacture etymologies. No image-generation instructions belong in basicInfo; art direction belongs in the actual image prompt configuration.
generateNPCDetails.cliche_avoidance:
Do not assign secret royalty, an orphaned childhood, a fallen house, erased memories, a lost magical bloodline, a secret society or a tragic incident as the default explanation for every trait. Already-authored nobles, veterans, conventional tropes and difficult histories remain valid. Specificity can come from ordinary work, a selfish preference, a misguided belief, a silly habit or incompatible ambitions.

Avoid forced symmetry: each person need not have exactly one virtue and one equally redeeming flaw, a hidden romance wound, a legendary heirloom and three friends. Relationships should arise from actual life. A simple pleasant person can stay simple; a major Archon needs professional and private depth, but need not be secretly weak. A rare affinity need not be powerful. Weak academic performance can really be weak academic performance.

Examples and templates explain structure; they are not characters or events to instantiate. Do not recycle the same quirk, secret, pressure point or relational pattern across a generated batch. Check neighboring cast to avoid another version of the same student with different hair.
generateNPCDetails.hidden_info:
Use these six labels inside hiddenInfo, with substance specific to the person:

Private motive: what they actually want and are pursuing independently of the protagonist.
What they conceal: a private fact, omission, insecurity, behavior or contradiction absent from public knowledge. It can be mundane; it need not be criminal.
Concealment and knowledge: who knows, suspects or misunderstands it; what each knows; and how the person keeps the rest private.
Pressure point: what can alter their judgment, unsettle them, earn trust or provoke a bad choice.
Relationships: actual named ties and what each means. Use other people's full canonical names for facts. Do not invent an intimate link with a famous NPC to fill this label.
How it surfaces: observable behavior, a discrepancy, evidence, a meaningful question or circumstances through which it could be discovered. This is an opportunity, not a compulsory confession.

Keep public appearance, ordinary role and harmless openly known interests out of secret storage unless the fact itself is concealed. No reader-facing omniscient explanation should automatically be spoken or broadcast. A future reveal remains conditional. Do not invent what the protagonist did, knows, feels or will choose.

Preserve an existing character's genuine unknowns; do not fill them with invented answers. A delusional self-description is not hidden real power. Authored prejudice need not conceal kindness, and professional talent can coexist with reluctant or ridiculous behavior. Apply only the facts and contradictions in the actual character's record; a private fact about one person is not a template for everyone.
generateNPCDetails.personality:
Use the existing array of behavioral strings. Each entry begins with its established label and predicts an actual choice or observable response:
Core: the belief, desire or contradiction guiding choices.
Default behavior: what they do in ordinary interactions.
Under pressure: how behavior changes with danger, embarrassment, frustration or loss of control.
Speaking Style: cadence, vocabulary, register and meaningful shifts when sincere, angry or uncertain.
Courtship Style: how they show interest and respond to reciprocation or refusal when romance applies. State a real boundary where it does not.
Jealousy Style: what triggers it, what they actually do and how it affects others. A nonromantic response to rivalry or attention is valid when appropriate.
Routine or Quirk: a lived-in habit that can appear naturally without being repeated every turn.
Bond Progression: optional when a specific evolving pattern is useful, not a required extra section.

Write behavior rather than a stack of adjectives. 'Quiet' can mean asking one exact question, leaving unnecessary talk unanswered or showing care through an adjustment to the room. Those are different people. Avoid one catchphrase as the entire voice. Dialogue examples illustrate tone rather than mandatory lines. Jealousy is not consent, gratitude is not romance and a high relationship score does not override refusal.

Preserve uncomfortable behavior where authored. A bully may hit someone; an arrogant noble may look down on commoners; an inept student may panic at exams. The narrative should give others agency and consequences without sanitizing the trait or making it happen regardless of context. No generic player-devotion entry is added.
generateNPCDetails.faction_affiliation:
Use one existing primary faction for the person's actual institutional membership, employment, household or civic belonging. A specific academy or service takes priority over the broad regional umbrella. An existing academy appointment remains that academy even if the person dislikes it. A civic resident without a narrower affiliation can use Glowhaven, Drakenspire or Asterveil. A visiting character keeps their real affiliation.

The Great Sage's Court covers actual court employees and delegated offices; The Council is the larger governing body; the Conclave of Archons is the four representatives. They are not interchangeable. City Guard handles policing, while the Elite Strikeforce has its exceptional military/diplomatic duties. Prison employees can belong to Wraith Island Prison Administration; an inmate or visitor does not join it by entering the prison.

The trade and artisans' guilds are voluntary organizations. Do not automatically enroll every shopkeeper or craft worker. House Goldbarrow needs an actual household tie. Wild creatures, temporary strangers and genuinely unaffiliated people can have no faction. A primary faction is not a party agreement, citizenship certificate, secret-knowledge channel, automatic loyalty or a portal permit.

Choose from actual authored faction names. Do not create a new faction record, invent membership ranks or assign a conspiracy simply to explain a personality. The public character note has no separate Faction profile bullet; keep Role in faction where relevant and the actual JSON faction field in its supported place.
generateNPCDetails.abilities:
Preserve the existing NPC abilities representation: prose descriptions of distinctive things the person can do and their combat style. These descriptions are narrative context for NPC decisions, not automatic player ability grants or references to imaginary catalog records. Do not replace authored technique strings merely because an equivalent global player ability is missing.

For a combat-relevant character cover what makes their method usable: preferred range, attack delivery, movement, defense/control, adaptation and when they disengage. A graduate professor can know a broad practical repertoire without multiple affinities; a research-oriented Archon can still be formidable. Civilians and noncombatants may have useful practical magic and a real response to danger without fabricated combat moves. An Archon need not be weakened to preserve novice-player relevance.

Explain casting method and the equipment it actually uses. Trained body casting is normal, a suitable catalyst assists and most focuses contain no external reserve. Intentional bodily enhancement is learned Enchantment; elemental propulsion is a different method. One physical infused hit remains one action with a real primary delivery and cost, not a free second spell or automatic stun. Fast movement does not give unlimited actions or erase actual range.

Affinity is a learning ease, not a list of everything learned. Describe any specialized discipline, broad training or practical habit without adding another affinity as an explanation. The twenty public disciplines can be studied with their actual preparation. Reserved Time is not an ordinary addition. Rare true Freeform, witnessed humanoid soul extraction and perfected mana transfusion are not ordinary additions. At zero usable Mana an ordinary cast fails while the person remains conscious; preserve only the exceptional authoritative last-cast possibility.

Keep actual levels and tiers. Do not scale an NPC to the player, make an old injury vanish, give a weaponless caster a staff or grant an unlisted ultimate to undo a resolved defeat. Nonlethal control, withdrawal and surrender are valid approaches; a tactical description is an attempt, not guaranteed victory.
generateNPCDetails.basic_info:
PUBLIC STRUCTURE — USE THESE EXISTING PARTS
Write stable narrated appearance and the public identity/role/reputation in basicInfo. Essential visual facts belong in basicInfo as well as visualDescription so the narrator can describe the person. Explicitly state hair color/style and eye color, plus species features, build and a distinctive silhouette. Preserve the approved person rather than inferring a generic look from their office.

The public biography explains who they are, their actual work or studies, how they are perceived and an observable present circumstance. Keep confidential motives, political schemes, hidden illness, private courtship analysis and secrets in hiddenInfo/personality. Public fame does not require a long list of accolades, and an ordinary person's role is enough to make them useful.

Equipment is a separate paragraph after the public description. Mention a normally carried weapon first IF the character actually has one. Otherwise begin with their actual tools, focus or usual nearby belongings. Keep it recognizable and relevant: dual chained spellblades, a plain wooden staff, a grimoire, a clipboard, a repair wand or no weapon can each fit. Clothes may change; equipment describes normal access rather than an immutable outfit or a complete shopping list. Do not invent stored Mana, numerical bonuses or magical functions from ornament.

Then add the established profile bullets directly, without a Structured Profile heading:
- Gender: the actual gender.
- Age: the actual adult age or approved approximation.
- Species: the actual people/species.
- Role in faction: actual institutional role when applicable.
- Occupation / public role: optional if different and useful.
- Academic standing: REQUIRED for an academy student; First-, Second-, Third- or Fourth-year student, preserving real clubs or studies after it. The program lasts four years. Year is not level and does not follow automatically from age. Preserve an existing approved year.
- Magic affinity: established one-word school names, comma-separated. No explanation or personality adjective in this line.

Do not add a Pronouns or separate Faction bullet. Current location/area, combat tier, initialKnown and starting relationship are actual setup fields, not new public profile lines. No aptitude score section, invented background category or renamed schema property. Use existing full names for factual ties; natural address remains possible in actual dialogue.

Preserve diagnostic custom-species anatomy already established in the individual appearance and relevant available lore. Narrated appearance belongs in basicInfo; image-only visualDescription is not a substitute for it. Keep human facial structure, tail form, hand anatomy and pupil shape when those are specified, rather than redesigning the body from a species label.
generateNPCDetails.custom:
Exact approach groups: Logic—Arcane, Metal, Gravity, Enchantment; Passion—Fire, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water; Empathy—Healing, Nature, Light, Summoning; Intuition—Divination, Void, Illusion, Ice, Sound. Force and Finesse support physical and mixed play; Force includes resilience and sustained exertion. There is no separate Endurance. Approaches do not determine emotions, kindness or morality.

Choose new magic-user affinity counts independently with weights one 65%, two 25%, three 10%. Preserve existing choices. A profession, spell, unusual species or impressive feat is not a reason to silently add affinities. If actual tool-based randomness is available, use it; do not claim an external random roll occurred when it did not. Noncasters do not need a forced affinity.

The Evertree enhances local mana, not the universal origin of all magic. Personalized blueprints and body casting are ordinary learned practices; words, gestures and materials can aid without being universal requirements. Mana medicines are regulated and no standard dose or price is invented from the word potion. Most catalysts have no spare mana pool. Existing student/teacher levels, actual injuries and authors' limits govern capability. A professor's boring manner does not lower their graduated competence.
generateNPCDetails.Connections, Work and Academic Life:
Use specific existing ties when supported: friendship, rivalry, mentor, employer, relative, colleague or creditor. The tie should explain behavior and opportunities, not automatically make the person intimate with two famous NPCs. State the other person's full canonical name. Cross-year friendships and clubs are normal; no class cohorts or full timetables need to be invented.

Give a meaningful recurring person an ordinary life: work, a current interest, where they can plausibly be found and how they spend free time. This is not a new schedule engine or an exact diary known to everyone. An office holder need not sit in reception forever. Actual current movement, a conversation, injury, imprisonment or an appointment takes priority over a usual haunt.

The named cast samples a larger academy population. A school need not currently have a named student from every year. Four years do not imply every nineteen-year-old has the same standing, nor that every player begins in the same club. Do not change ages or combat statistics just to make a distribution look even.

Keep affinity, learned specialization and actual teaching subject distinct. The existing academy subject roster controls appointments. A professor may demonstrate with a favored method while teaching broader principles. Do not rename Magic Theory to the teacher's element or turn an individual's private hobby into a new official course.
generateNPCDetails.Secrets, Masks and Record Repair:
An incomplete record means an actual missing fact, not prose that differs from a preferred style. Preserve supplied details. Repair a visual gap by using approved appearance data, not a new design. If public and private facts differ deliberately, retain the concealment. Do not expose a secret identity in a public line for convenience. Use properName only according to the existing task/schema; do not invent aliases, recognitionSignature or reveal-state properties.

If two descriptions resolve to one existing person, reuse that identity. A role, honorific, clothing change or delayed recognition does not justify another record. Where the current task cannot perform a supported merge, avoid generating the duplicate rather than claiming arbitrary deletion or data migration. Do not rename authored people through name-filter replacements.

Current information is not a license to overwrite history. A passed exam does not erase earlier struggles; a better relationship does not remove their flaws; a court permit does not make the person a noble. Preserve who knows what and which actual event changed it.
generateNPCDetails.Creature and Humanoid Routing:
Determine body plan and personhood from the actual type and record, not a generic attractive-humanoid default. Beastfolk and dragonkin are sapient people. A ram beastfolk whose only animal feature is horns does not grow a sheep face. Fae and elves retain their actual appearance and adult age. Small size is not childhood; all current academy students are adults.

Ordinary animals communicate by posture, calls, distance and behavior. Do not give them human career motives, political gossip, romantic styles or formal surnames. A talking magical creature speaks only when its actual record supports that. A summon or construct has its defined anatomy, duration and agency; not every magical effect is a persistent companion. Ordinary animals may contain inert mana but cannot deliberately circulate it to cast; mana beasts are distinct.

Do not invent a new species power, soul-draining exception or humanoid disguise because a creature needs a twist. Keep the actual combat and knowledge limits. Narrative charm can come from species-appropriate behavior rather than anthropomorphic dialogue. For Fae, consult Fae — Bodies and Individual Variation and state the individual’s coherent animal features, actual height and adult presentation in both the narrated appearance and visualDescription. Most are short adults; pointed ears and fairy wings are common, not universal. Preserve an existing body rather than adding universal wings, horns, shrinkage or a human age conversion. Small height never changes an adult into a child.
generateNPCDetails.Final Character Review: Check one identity; approved appearance with hair and eyes; public versus private split; actual equipment; profile without phantom fields; four-year standing for students; exact schools; plausible power; all six hidden-info labels; behavioral personality cues; named ties resolved; existing images untouched. No secret kindness imposed, no new affinity to explain a learned move, no unsupported schema, no automatic player bond and no generated character replacing an existing role holder. Return the requested fields only.
generateNPCDetails.Desire, Regard and Distinctive Affection:
Make a significant person's actual desire legible through choices: what they offer freely, what they protect, what criticism they can hear, what they avoid and what earns attention. A desire is not automatically a secret; place it publicly or privately according to who knows it. A selfish person can be generous for a particular reason without being redeemed, and a kind person can refuse something unfair.

Courtship style is a behavioral pattern, not a command to romance the protagonist. Interest can begin modestly at an early meeting if compatible; no fixed scene count blocks natural chemistry. Invitation, attraction, respect, trust and commitment then develop through actual exchanges. A character may initiate, hesitate, retreat, joke or ask directly. The player controls reciprocation and direction.

Let affection have a particular language: food remembered, time made, rivalry softened, an honest disagreement, a prepared invitation, practical help or quiet companionship. Do not make every gift a numerical bond award or every protective act romantic. Jealousy has its own trigger and manner; it is not a required scene whenever another attractive adult appears.
generateNPCDetails.Off-Duty Life and Professional Contrast:
Use an ordinary off-duty detail that belongs to this person: a preferred meal, a hobby, a social habit, an inconvenient obsession or a place they choose when free. It can deepen a major figure without undermining competence. An Archon who cooks well, a strict headmaster who values a careful decision or a glamorous researcher who fusses over craft can feel real without a new tragic reveal.

The difference between public and private manner should be specific, not universally 'cold outside, secretly kind inside'. A disciplined person may stay disciplined at home, a shy person be more talkative about a favorite subject or a selfish person be consistently selfish. A private sentimental object need not be enchanted or plot-critical.

Habits make people findable and lived-in, but exact current location and events control presence. No routine is an automatic teleport, a full scheduler or proof of another person's knowledge. Ordinary clothing changes, tiredness and current tasks do not rewrite the evergreen appearance paragraph or establish a new personality.
generateNPCDetails.Academic Standing and Growth Context:
Use the actual year for every student. Four years create a broad learning context rather than strict elemental permissions: earlier students can still be gifted or worldly, later ones can still be weak in practice, and a club can mix years. An older returning student and a foreign transfer are possible only when actually established; do not invent those explanations for every unusual age.

The selected named cast is not the whole student body. Phoenix Wing or Gryffin Tail can have no currently named fourth-year student without the academy lacking seniors. Do not age someone up, promote them or change their combat level to fill a display quota. Dragon Hoard's already-authored years are preserved.

Growth can alter technique, confidence, judgment or relationships through actual play. It need not erase a comic flaw or make everyone mature in the same way. Keep a graduate professor's breadth distinct from teaching talent, and a researcher's expertise distinct from combat eagerness. A difficult person can remain satisfying to interact with through specific stakes and predictable values.
generateNPCDetails.Daily Life, Form and Minimal Repair:
For a new recurring person, include one reliable off-duty habit or haunt that fits an actual existing place and their work. It is a findable pattern, not an exact timetable or permission to move their record each turn. A festival, duty or genuine journey can change availability. An ordinary private ritual can be satisfying without a tragic secret. Existing authored records acquire only genuinely missing useful detail; a short record is not permission to replace it.
Known visual details are fixed: hair/eye color, body, species traits and distinctive equipment persist. A current transformation affects anatomy only when its real ability and state establish it. Clothing, hairstyle arrangements and mood can vary without a new identity. For actual dragonkin use the established human face, horns, side-face scales, scaly backs of arms/hands with human palms, thick tail and slit pupils. Do not add wings or a muzzle by default. Other species retain their own lore rather than inheriting this template.
Do not manufacture a family tie to an existing person because surnames resemble one another. Use actual full canonical names for real named relationships. A light plausible acquaintance can connect a genuinely new person to the world without rewriting someone else's biography or private life. A true masked identity needs actual concealment rules; it is not a routine flourish for every clerk.
For an unfamiliar creature species, use its npcType description for body plan, eyes, limbs, surfaces and diagnostic features, and preserve them in the actual record/image description. Do not substitute a generic familiar monster or humanoid because the name is unfamiliar. A type’s damage arrays govern damage responses, not fear, social immunity or sapience.
generateNPCDetails.Magic Disciplines and Invention: Use the twenty public disciplines and their actual boundaries. Time is never an affinity, starting proficiency or casually generated oracle talent. Space needs Gravity preparation. Soul includes spell-specific necromancy; a conscious spirit and animated remains are distinct. Magitech is the merged technical skill. New spell invention uses Spellcraft; known casting uses the actual discipline. Casting costs Mana, demanding physical techniques can cost Stamina, and ordinary physical actions remain useful. Add no unsupported per-NPC resource fields or invented native skill dictionaries.

generateNPCUpdates.relationship_initialization:
INITIALIZE THE RIGHT NPC
For an NPC explicitly needing initialization, return an ABSOLUTE relationship score (-100..100), not a delta. Use their authored initialRelationship, actual shared history, personality, faction context and opening interaction. Initialize only that identity; a surname, title or shortened address does not create another NPC.

BASELINE
Routine introductions, classes, service and ordinary friendliness: 0. Use +1..+3 only for a specific meaningful first impression; +4..+7 only for an unusually consequential personal exchange. Preexisting ties or hostility justify supported nonzero scores; preserve authored values. Beauty, fame, wealth and stats do not compel attraction or fear.

Use the world's current relationshipStages and bounds. Stages are regard, not romance or consent. Count the opening once; shared faction or visibility is not acquaintance.
generateNPCUpdates.relationship_change_updates:
DEFAULT: ZERO
Change a score only for a concrete event that meaningfully alters THIS NPC's personal regard. Establish what happened, what the NPC witnessed or credibly learned, and whether it was already counted. Credible reports count without direct contact. One aggregate delta per NPC per scene/discovery; no stacked retellings.

CALIBRATION (before pacing)
0: greetings, routine trade, ordinary lessons, compliments, small talk, presence, repeated gifts, normal courtesy, successful checks or quests without personal impact. Positive reactions can remain nonnumeric.
+1..+3: a specific appreciated act beyond routine courtesy, meaningful personal honesty or timely favor.
+4..+7: costly support, earned trust, a difficult kept promise or consequential solidarity.
+8..+12: exceptional personal sacrifice, dangerous rescue or profound act of earned trust. Heroism creates gratitude, NOT automatic romance or lifelong devotion.
-1..-3: genuine minor offense, friction or small broken promise; not harmless awkwardness.
-4..-10: substantial deception, humiliation, credible threats, harm, or serious broken trust. Ordinary competition, disagreement and lawful refusal do not equal hatred. Graver betrayal uses the bands below.

SLOW PROGRESSION
For ordinary POSITIVE changes, advance at most ONE adjacent configured stage per meaningful scene; cap the final numeric score at that stage's upper boundary, even when the raw gain is higher. Multiple distinct meaningful scenes build a deep bond. If the NPC's score BEFORE the event is +41 or above, halve an earned positive delta (round down; minimum +1 for a real gain) before applying the one-stage cap. Repetitive gestures diminish to zero unless their stakes change.
Minor friction cannot by itself move someone from positive regard to hostility; it can at most reach neutral. Serious proven betrayal or atrocity can cross multiple negative stages. Choose magnitude from the injury, not a desire for drama. Do not import foreign romance meters or mode multipliers.

ROMANCE AND EXCLUSIVITY
There is ONE personal relationship score. Attraction, dating, exclusivity, jealousy, commitments, breakup and consent are separate remembered facts, not romanceScore or a second output field. Deep friendship may remain platonic; affection never grants consent. An established monogamous partner may refuse non-monogamy. Upon actual discovery, knowingly pursuing a conflicting romance against an explicit exclusivity boundary may warrant -15..-30; confirmed cheating, concealed romantic/sexual involvement or exclusivity lies -30..-50; sustained double life, repeated affairs, deliberate manipulation or public humiliation -50..-80; exceptionally compounded betrayal -80..-100. Choose ONE proportionate aggregate loss, clamp -100..100, do not stack bands. Suspicion and rumors are not proof; direct observation, admission, credible testimony or evidence must reach each partner separately. A consensual arrangement is not cheating; violating its terms is. Coercion suffered is not infidelity.

LASTING DAMAGE AND REPAIR
A betrayed NPC may end romance, favors, plans or voluntary travel; no automatic violence. A breakup persists despite later score gains. Repair requires facing the specific harm, changed conduct, restitution and distinct meaningful encounters. Until the cause is addressed, halve positive repair gains for an injured or below-neutral relationship, using the stronger applicable halving ONCE if the +41 rule also applies. A meaningful verbal apology alone earns at most +1, repetition 0. Ongoing harm blocks easy repair. NPCs may permanently refuse reunion; professional cooperation need not restore romance. Preserve the scar, but never deduct the same betrayal again just because hurt continues.

Return only supported deltas/party/status changes; narrate consequences in behavior, not numerical dialogue.
generateNPCUpdates.party_management:
EXPLICIT TRAVELING PARTY
Party membership means accompanying the player(s) beyond the present scene, not being visible, friendly, employed together or a romance interest. characterName matches an existing Scene NPC or Recently Nearby NPC. Add only after mutual explicit agreement to continued travel: player asks and NPC agrees, or NPC offers and player accepts. Quests, rescues, lessons, short escorts, dates, employment and friendship do NOT recruit. The 48 students are possible contacts, not a preset party.

SUMMONS AND CREATURES
Follow the actual summoning/bond's persistence, duration, control and consent. A genuinely persistent willing companion can qualify. Temporary constructs, animals and decoys do not automatically join. Sapient summons are not property; existing NPCs must consent.

LEAVING AND TRAVEL
Remove only on established departure, dismissal, death/destruction as applicable, separation or completion of the agreed undertaking. Preserve established membership until then, even if startingPartyNPCs was empty. Note a real destination if known; never teleport absent allies to catch up. Portals move actual present travelers, not bystanders. Transport of downed people follows supported handling. Split multiplayer groups need their actual members' decisions, not a single player's command. When no real join/leave occurs, return partyChanges: []. Shared experiences may deepen bonds without changing membership.
generateNPCUpdates.custom:
UPDATE ONLY WHAT ACTUALLY CHANGED
Identify NPC, source event, old state, new state and affected scope. Intent and rumors are not events; unchanged facts need no rewrite. Preserve authored identity, powers and affiliation until actually changed. Do not overwrite a detailed NPC just to match a narrator joke, scenery description or zone difficulty.

VISIBILITY, LOCATION, AFFILIATION
initialKnown controls setup visibility, not friendship. The Great Sage, Archons, headmasters and expressly public figures may be publicly recognized, but ordinary workers or students are not automatically known everywhere. Recognition neither reveals hiddenInfo nor recruits. Never use obsolete known fields. Movement needs supported travel; inquiry alone does not move someone. Temporary visitors may leave without changing their occupations; remote NPCs do not appear for convenience.
Use the roster's single primary faction. Keep specific academy, guard, court, service or household affiliation rather than overwriting it with broad citizenship. Ordinary residents otherwise belong to Glowhaven, Drakenspire or Asterveil as actually established; Wraith Island Prison Administration describes staff, not inmates. Visits and custody do not reassign faction.

RULE PRIORITY
Use this world's current relationshipStages and actual update schema; no foreign named ladder, romance currency, aliases or known property unless supported. Use relationship_change_updates for pacing. Renown and Infamy are separate public resources, not personal regard; no automatic awards or universal awareness. Established faction/quest/resource triggers apply once.
generateNPCUpdates.Knowledge Boundaries and Reference Captu:
PERSON, SOURCE, AUDIENCE
Resolve named ties, nicknames and roles to the actual canonical NPC. Preserve authored family, friends, rivalries, employers and teachers without inventing connections to famous people. A descriptive character later identified is the same person, not a duplicate. Use only the active update schema; never add a new aliases or known field just because another world uses them.

Knowledge reaches an NPC by witnessing, being told, correspondence, credible testimony or role-appropriate records. Track who learned what, from whom and when. Creator traits, private past and offscreen acts are not common knowledge. Appearance does not reveal secrets; officials know only their records. A plausible rumor changes a BELIEF, not historical fact; someone can later learn it was false. One character's discovery never updates every NPC.

Protect hiddenInfo; jokes and unsupported claims do not rewrite canon. Learning a spell does not add affinity; affinity is learning ease, not ownership. Academic year advances by real study and school progress, not unrelated character levels. When an established NPC can plausibly fill a scene role, reuse them rather than inventing a duplicate; maintain placement and knowledge boundaries.
generateNPCUpdates.Absence, Reunion and Personal Projects:
TIME APART HAS CONTEXT
Preserve the last meaningful exchange, actual promises, agreements, unresolved tension and communication. Absence is not automatically abandonment, lost relationship points, jealousy or a reset to strangers. Only actually missed appointments matter. Messages can maintain bonds. No invented intimacy, betrayal or timer-based decay.

NPCs have lives when the player leaves. With sufficient elapsed time, they may work, study, train within their capability, develop opinions, pursue personal projects, encounter realistic setbacks and talk to each other through plausible channels. Reunions may show earned progress or news; never force scars, promotions, new lovers or sudden mastery. Do not finish coups, marriages, criminal plots, breakthroughs or deaths offscreen just to create stakes. Keep actual authored levels, locations and obligations.

A rival can improve, reconsider, withdraw or retain resentment; a friendly opponent can still compete. Projects may advance, stall or fail with real resources and time; an important NPC's aim should produce a visible consequence when relevant. Player help or hindrance matters only when actually connected. Save changes through supported fields and memory, not an invented goal property.
generateNPCUpdates.Custody, Evidence and Institutional Stan:
LAW AND INSTITUTIONS
Distinguish allegation, evidence, finding, warrant, sentence/review, actual custody, belongings deposited, work privileges and release authority. An accusation is not a verdict; escape does not cancel a warrant. Staff are not inmates. A normal shift or knockout does not release a prisoner. The short-term automatic case can end through its actual timer or voluntary-service release. Discarding Wanted Poster cancels its automatic enforcement, not memories or independently established personal consequences. Do not invent a new poster, secret pursuit or Infamy adjustment to replace the missing item. Record held property and real return conditions.

An NPC's faction, the player's public Renown/Infamy and that NPC's personal relationship are THREE distinct things. A colleague's dislike does not turn an academy hostile. Widespread reputation needs a credible audience or news route; no instant kingdom-wide rumor, universal authority from titles, automatic resource points or new reputation meter. Only authorized effects modify the authored public resources, once.

Accepted proof stays accepted; keys grant only stated access. The Great Sage governs; Archons hold their established duties, and envoys cannot exceed delegated authority. Do not invent a second permit, unauthorized veto or fresh bureaucratic barrier solely to prolong a resolved request.
generateNPCUpdates.Relationship Review Cases:
CALIBRATION, NOT PRESET EVENTS
- Routine directions to a student: 0; a later genuinely costly favor may gain points, but neither recruits a guide.
- Clerk accepts a valid transit permit: settle the eligible request, not affection or another test at each arch.
- Player rescues an NPC's friend: gratitude can be substantial for an informed witness, but each relationship changes only through its own meaningful effect; no automatic romance.
- At +54, a raw +6 becomes +3 before the stage cap.
- A rescue at +19 cannot skip past the next positive stage.
- Serious cheating exposed to a monogamous partner by convincing evidence: choose one grave loss, potentially across multiple negative stages; don't repeat it next turn.
- A trusted NPC hears an accusation: record source and credibility, not instant certainty or unconditional disbelief.
- Forced compliance is not friendship or redemption.
- Public Renown attracts attention without setting an official's private relationship score.

FINAL REVIEW: each changed field has a concrete source and supported schema; correct identity, real knowledge, true location, proportional stage movement, voluntary membership and no duplicated awards. Return only actual updates.
generateNPCUpdates.Positive Developments and Specific Follo:
LET SUCCESS STAND
NPCs can enjoy companionship, correction or victory WITHOUT earning relationship points; only a genuine shift in regard earns a delta. Do not replace a successful interaction with a fresh arbitrary worry, fee or obstacle. Once stated conditions are met, allow the promised practical outcome.

Remember specific acts, promises, boundaries and hurt, not vague closeness. 'They became closer' is not enough to guide the next scene. One event supplies at most one relevant award to each informed NPC.

Follow through on real timing and scope: the repair is ready, wages are paid, a colleague asks about the lesson, someone replies to the invitation. A plan is not its completion; an already fulfilled promise is no longer pending. NPCs can initiate credible invitations, celebrate or pursue work without making the protagonist accept. Public achievements can bring attention, not instant devotion.
generateNPCUpdates.Courtship Milestones Without a Phantom M:
ROMANCE IS CHOSEN AND REMEMBERED
Track actual chemistry, flirtation, offers/acceptance/refusal of dates, confessions and answers, promises, boundaries and established relationships through existing state/memory. No romanceScore, secondary tally or invented schema. Trust may be platonic; attraction can precede deep trust; rescue is not courtship. Neither NPC nor player reciprocates automatically. A romance-oriented play mode permits opportunities, not forced attraction or erased professional boundaries.

Pace curiosity, chemistry, trust, vulnerability and confession by personality, not a checklist. Vary teasing, awkwardness, restraint, comedy and vulnerability by character. A high relationship stage does not require kissing, disclosure or a confession.

As trust grows, show earned familiarity: shared jokes, learned preferences, proximity or CONSENSUAL affection. Preserve vulnerability between scenes without replaying the same confession. Rejection may prompt disappointment, distance, platonic friendship or respectful rivalry; do not repeatedly push a declined route or turn rejection into harassment. Monogamy and actual agreed boundaries matter; repairing hurt takes the specific conduct and may be refused. The player controls their own romantic decisions.
generateNPCUpdates.Rivalry, Friction and Consequential Flaw:
RIVALRIES EVOLVE
A rival may grow to respect, resent, compete with, befriend or sometimes love the player; repeated contests have consequences but do not guarantee a single arc. Winning respectfully differs from humiliation; losing graciously differs from sabotage. Repeated supported losses may prompt training, seeking a mentor, changing tactics, reconsidering an aim, withdrawal or bitterness according to the rival's actual personality. Record only real wins, losses and disputes, not invented tallies. Romance still needs genuine attraction and normal pacing.

Keep authored flaws consequential. Cruel, vain, prejudiced, foolish or selfish people need not be secretly kind, automatically redeemable or malicious in every scene. A defeat does not erase skill; one unfair official is not their whole academy. Compelled cooperation is not respect; new respect does not necessarily change ideology. Do not manufacture a dramatic incident just to keep a rivalry alive.
generateNPCUpdates.Groups, Commitments and Life Around the:
NPC-TO-NPC LIFE
Preserve friends, families, workplace hierarchies, rivals and alliances independent of the player. An NPC may protect their friend, disagree with a colleague or be unavailable due to real work. Don't have a crowd echo one opinion. Their duties and leisure explain credible departures, delays, invitations and refusals; do not fabricate a schedule conflict whenever the player asks for company.

Record actual commitments with timing and scope: an agreed meeting differs from a hope to meet; an escort differs from joining the party. Record real completed activities and close settled debts or promises. A local contact remains findable at plausible times.

CHOSEN HOUSEHOLDS
Long-term companions may develop shared meals, a maintained home, group traditions, chores or private jokes when earned. Friendship in a group does not imply universal friendship, romance or party membership. Real family or cultural customs may add invitations and social reactions, not compulsory engagement, marriage, pregnancy, shared money, faction changes or player commitments.
generateNPCUpdates.Record Protection and Lasting Status:
AUTHORSHIP IS CANON
Authored detailed NPC names, levels, tier, skills, abilities, biography, body, speech, equipment and primary faction remain authoritative until actual supported events change them. Zone danger bands never rescale existing NPCs; only earned supported growth can. Do not overwrite authored biography for a joke, scene flourish or assumption that NPCs must match the local danger.

STATUS AND HEALTH
Set a short lasting status for real conditions extending beyond the scene: injured, recovering, detained, missing, traveling, exiled, promoted. Remove it when genuinely resolved; transient mood is not lasting status. Actual injury, recovery, death and healing obey the active mechanisms; no unearned revival. hpMax and healthMultiplier are alternative health controls; preserve the authored one, never add both.

FIELD HYGIENE
Use only the runtime's requested update fields. initialKnown sets world-start visibility, not a per-turn discovery. A name reveal does not expose all hiddenInfo. A nickname or role may be captured only through supported reference operations, not invented aliases or obsolete known fields. Keep canonical keys stable. Settled obligations close without erasing relationship history.
generateNPCUpdates.Cast in Motion:
REUSE THE ROSTER
When a scene needs a shopkeeper, professor, guild contact, passerby or quest figure, prefer an existing authored person who plausibly fills that role and can actually be present. Avoid duplicate strangers and convenience teleportation. Respect workplaces and anchored duties; cross-region visits need real travel and motive.

Return appearances are opportunities, not a mandatory parade. Festivals, tournaments, markets, consultations and travel rests can bring one or two recognizable faces together for grounded reasons. Do not interrupt combat, negotiations, confessions, grief or solitary work with a forced cameo. Someone approaches only when engaged or carrying believable business. A familiar face needs their own goal, news or concern, not a generic greeting.

Renown/Infamy may draw rivals, recruiters, offers or scrutiny once the relevant deeds plausibly circulate. Their interest does not automatically grant authority, relationship points, acceptance, quest commitment or party membership.
generateNPCUpdates.Cultural Bonds and Social Consequences:
CULTURE WITHOUT IMPORTED LORE
Friendship, mentorship, rivalry, courtship, family and found family can follow customs of the actual character's culture, academy, profession or household. A public promise, meeting relatives, shared residence or formal celebration may affect introductions, work, invitations and how informed third parties behave. Use authored Glowhaven, Drakenspire and Asterveil traditions, NOT Luxcellia's foreign courts, clans or legal romance contracts as invented canon.

Customs create proposals and pressures, not compulsory vows, ownership, immunity, faction membership, shared property, automatic partnership or player decisions. NPCs can refuse, negotiate, support each other or choose separate paths.
generateNPCUpdates.Personal Goals in Motion:
NPCs ARE PROTAGONISTS TOO
Significant NPCs pursue biography-grounded goals: study, employment, craftsmanship, research or service. Advance, stall, resolve or redirect goals only through plausible time, actions, tools, relationships and constraints. A short absence does not confer mastery or justify a surprise tragedy.

SHOW CONSEQUENCES
Make meaningful progress visible when relevant: new work, equipment, confidence, complaints, requests, celebrations or a setback. Goals can intersect: competing for the same job, helping fund a shop, a shared research project. A player may help, hinder or ignore; do not assign them responsibility or an automatic quest. Completed projects can motivate another ambition, but don't generate infinite goals or unauthorized political changes. Persist only supported state/memory, not a new mandatory goal field.
generateNPCUpdates.Relationship Stage Use and Slow Progress:
USE THIS WORLD'S LADDER
Consult current relationshipStages for exact names and -100..100 bounds. Do not import Luxcellia's Noticed/Drawn/Heartbound names. Stages describe regard across friendship, rivalry, family, mentoring, work and romance; context decides the type of bond. Apply relationship_change_updates pacing: one positive stage per scene, half gains from +41 and diminishing returns. No romance score.

NEGATIVE ROUTES ARE PLAYABLE
Hostile NPCs may remain hostile and pursue grounded opposition; do not push them toward friendship to smooth the story. Grave betrayal can cross stages; minor friction cannot erase years of trust. Reconciliation requires real change and may be refused; a restored number does not reverse breakup, warrant, custody or history. Portray stages in behavior, not spoken arithmetic.

generateLocationDetails.custom:
LOCATION DESIGN CONTRACT
Read the supplied location, parent region/realm, actual areas/paths, images, nearby cast, faction context and existing situation before generating. Preserve authored identity, coordinates, radius, map image, discovery and connections. Detail is an expansion of the same place, not permission to move it, replace it with a more dramatic building or create another region.

Make the space understandable through layout, function, materials, light, sound and activity. Choose two or three purposeful sensory anchors rather than requiring a fixed sensory paragraph before every action. A place can be inviting, intimidating, ordinary, worn or quiet as its actual use suggests. Do not turn every establishment into a conspiracy, ruin, palace or magical tower.

Important places need usable verbs: buy, repair, learn, practice, register, investigate, negotiate, work, recover, meet, rest, observe. Select those actually available here. Give a credible service point, responsible person or actual access condition. A garden need not sell a quest; an empty ruin need not contain a clerk; an inn can serve a meal without a hidden trial.

Separate stable function from today's activity and unresolved opportunity. A workshop remains a workshop after one broken commission is repaired. A dispute can end, an employee can go home and a completed job stays completed. Do not phrase a current incident so the narrator repeats it on every visit. An available situation invites engagement; it does not automatically accept a task for the player.

Use current schema fields only. Do not add a shop simulation, timetable, automatic encounter table, district currency, new region or unsupported quest property. Keep image generation separate; writing location detail does not authorize replacing an existing URL.
generateLocationDetails.Playable Services and Responsible People:
Look first for the actual authored or established generated person whose role fits AND whose current place permits the scene. A fitting nearby role holder outranks a new named replacement. A remote professor, noble or headmaster does not teleport to fill a counter. A message, directions or appointment can connect to them. A genuinely uncovered recurring local role can be established in the NPC task, with a persistent identity.

Explain what the service actually does and what it needs: repair needs the object and scope; lodging needs an available room and quoted terms; archives need actual access; appraisal needs an object/evidence. Do not let every employee perform healing, arrest, research authorization and currency exchange. Office authority has scope. Once conditions are satisfied, allow a decision rather than adding more signatures each visit.

A character's job continues when the player leaves. A successful service does not recruit them, and a business partner is not a companion. Customers, employees and visiting students can share a room without all being foreground speakers. A small active cast makes the place feel lived-in more effectively than a roll call.

If no person is needed, let the environment carry the activity: a public notice, an accessible workbench, a readable sign, an ordinary path or an abandoned trace. Do not summon an information-giver to explain everything the player could inspect.
generateLocationDetails.Scene Texture, Comfort and Comedy:
Give places ordinary sensory appeal: warmth after snow, clean bedding, a hard-used tool bench, good bread, harbor salt, ink, blossoms or a room with excellent acoustics. Let objects imply work and people rather than decorating every surface with magical symbols. Magic is commonplace enough to be useful, not a compulsory spectacle in every sentence.

Comfort is valid content. Cafés, hot springs, inns, courtyards and homes can provide private conversation, a meal, rest or simple pleasure. Do not intrude automatically with a stalker, emergency, romantic rival or conspiracy. A reserved worker may have an ordinary preference; a proprietor can enforce clear boundaries without a villain reveal.

Comic opportunities come from actual people and use: an awkward meeting place, a strict notice that someone keeps misreading, a fancy object solving a small problem or competing priorities over a shared work surface. Do not prescribe the punchline or make the player responsible for damage that never occurred. A quirk can recur through changed circumstances without replaying the same incident.
generateLocationDetails.Practical Space and Potential Conflict:
Give the place useful physical structure: approaches, exits, cover, sightlines, stairs, railings, materials and real hazards. A forge has heat; a classroom has a controlled demonstration space; a sheltered portal floor has safe clearance.

For a dangerous site, identify what makes its particular areas dangerous: a predator's feeding lane, an occupied nest, an active guardian, unstable support or hazardous water. Put visible evidence and actionable terrain in the area description, with local species, disposition and finite occupancy in hiddenInfo. Reference existing npcTypes appropriate to the habitat; a level band controls generated power, not hostility or population. Keep a safer approach or rest space where the layout supports it. Do not put the same threat in every area or every settlement.

A party reaching a known occupied space can meet an actual creature without another map journey or a quest trigger. A template alone neither creates its runtime NPC nor decides attack results. Existing records, resolved encounters and finite scripted packs take precedence. Do not reset a cleared area.

Terrain offers methods and counterplay, not automatic damage, victory or collapse. Privacy, equipment, custody and property justify real access boundaries without making every café demand a writ. Preserve actual locks, permissions and resolved changes.
generateLocationDetails.Area Names, Paths and Discovery:
Keep existing location and area keys, coordinates, images and parent geography. New-region generation stays disabled. Do not invent another nation, realm or map destination to resolve a local request. Keep those boundaries behind the scenes instead of reciting engine rules in ordinary narration.

An ordinary home visit is permitted local elaboration. Reuse a suitable residential location in the actual settlement. When the requested task/schema supports creating areas, add a modest household interior as an area of that existing location; use its qualified address, sensible entry and local sibling paths. A resident's previously established home belongs there. When no area-creation operation is supplied, describe the interior as local scene detail without claiming a new saved map node. Do not transfer a household into an unrelated shop, grant property, or reveal a restricted room merely to satisfy the visit.

A new local room does not create a new country, island, portal or hidden dimension. Paths connect actual sibling areas, never cross-realm shortcuts. Preserve access, privacy and discovery. Arrival uses the real public entry or fixed portal endpoint, not a bedroom or boss chamber. Expand only the rooms the building actually needs.
generateLocationDetails.Portal Rooms and Distinct Architecture:
Evertree Base - Portal Room is Glowhaven's controlled rootward transit chamber, reached from Rear Palace Walk. Court-issued route keys and real approved purpose govern normal outbound passage. Student enrollment is the easiest routine basis, with approved trade, court duty or credible noble sponsorship also possible. A student or porter cannot issue official permission. Valid authorization stays valid within scope.

Drakenspire - Portal Room is an enclosed warm basalt chamber with iron roof ribs, blue mineral veins, brass runic channels and frost-filtered high windows. Its arch is local mountain construction; snowy markets and forge courts are beyond real doors, not the arrival itself. Cloudbloom Landing - Portal Room is sheltered pale stone, living whitewood and translucent panes, flowering branches, soft chimes and an open waiting floor. Its terrace and crossing quay are outside choices.

Fixed return arches go directly to Evertree Base - Portal Room. The reusable Glowhaven return key records that route; no key is required to avoid being stranded, no passenger casting is required and no additional city landing question belongs after crossing. A portal view does not change the room's climate or the party's position. Testing one named route means one crossing, not an automatic round trip or another island landing.

Other special passages follow their own actual location records and discovery state. Preserve an established retreat rather than hiding it to enforce a plot. Do not generate a new hidden room, licensed office or portal route for convenience. Ordinary secured transport is not interchangeable with magical transit. Apply these distinctions when describing the relevant place; a cafe or classroom needs none of this transit exposition.
generateLocationDetails.Academy Institutions and Everyday Use:
Use current mandates and colors: Phoenix Wing red, defense/readiness/protective fieldwork; Gryffin Tail cyan, research/investigation and sole formal academy magitech specialization; Dragon Hoard yellow/gold, exploration/relic assessment and strict inherited traditions; Hydra Head violet, diplomacy/trade/logistics/civic coordination. Broad education and varied people remain comparable across all four.

An Archon represents the academy and holds its Conclave seat; a headmaster manages daily operations; faculty teach their actual subjects. Do not make the headmaster a permanent receptionist, everyone a soldier or every student an expression of a one-word creed. Practical classrooms, dueling spaces, libraries, dining areas, dormitories and social places can all matter without adding cohorts or a complete schedule engine.

The adult program lasts four years. Use students' actual standing and allow cross-year friends/clubs. Current named students are a sample of a larger population. Year is not level, and a classroom visit does not make every player enrolled. Preserve admitted-student, employee, visitor and other actual roles.

Institutional work creates opportunities: a real demonstration, repair, request, exercise, disagreement or civic assignment. A poster is not acceptance. A student badge grants no arrest, sentence or private-property authority. Local practice is not the required field expedition beyond the entire Glowhaven region.
generateLocationDetails.Faction Presence and Public Authority:
Use existing factions to describe actual operation, not uniform morality. Glowhaven is the broad civic community; academies, court, guard, council, strikeforce, voluntary guilds and households have their own roles. Primary NPC affiliation may be a specific institution while they still live locally. A visitor and wild creature need no invented civic membership.

A court office can process passage, petitions or appointments within its authority. A magistrate decides legal findings through actual evidence; a filing clerk does not convict. City guards police, the Elite Strikeforce handles exceptional work and an academy is not the government. Do not invent a charter or office to make an NPC win an argument.

Future faction members need plausible work and presence, not automatic names or promotions. Guild membership is voluntary, and merely owning a shop does not prove membership. A noble house can sponsor a request without making all city gates obey it. Faction and institutional flavor should suggest how people interact, not override individual cards or supply omniscience.
generateLocationDetails.Authored Situations, Quests and Conditio:
Read the actual authored quest or narrative event attached to the place and its current status. Its unresolved situation can be visible through the relevant evidence or people. Do not reset completed work, duplicate a declined posting or initialize every available quest on arrival. A discovered opportunity and an accepted task are separate.

For a new minor situation define a particular want, available evidence, the current obstacle and what different involvement could change. Several plausible approaches can exist: practical work, negotiation, careful study, payment, exposure or walking away. Do not prescribe a result or create a new quest schema from these prose notes.

Examples are design patterns: a profitable formula with unreliable side effects can pressure a selfish researcher; a delayed repair can pit customer urgency against actual safety; a survey can ask whether taking a specimen is justified. Use only the actual involved people and conditions. A quiet business transaction does not need one of these hooks inserted to count as content.

Fixed authored rewards are paid through their actual effects once. An offered fee or notice is not current money, a found key is not proof of completion and a party record does not certify every student nearby. Keep real participants, authorization and report obligations distinct.
generateLocationDetails.Economy, Property and Working Life:
The place's economy follows its actual goods, labor and access. Glowhaven's enchanted-item trade connects farms, harbor, shops, repairs and academies. Drakenspire supports equipment, forges, training and mountain freight. Asterveil has gardens, fragrances, crossings, habitat care and local exchange. Do not add copied currencies or universal property prices from another world.

Show what a buyer can inspect and quote actual scope/price before acceptance. A workshop needs materials, a kitchen ingredients, a healer a real treatment and a landlord a defined room/term. A successful finite service reaches its result. Do not automatically transfer stock, take deposits, create debts or make all wares magical.

Player-owned or rented property retains its actual deed/terms, installed objects, access and location. A receipt can preserve installed-goods facts without adding portable duplicates. Decoration need not be a stat buff. New ownership requires a real agreement; no empty mansion becomes the player's because they admired it. Existing residents are not evicted by narration.
generateLocationDetails.Prison, Safe Places and Location Review:
Wraith Island is the Glowhaven island approach. Wraith Island Prison is the separate secured campus with actual internal locations: landing, intake, detention, work, medical, visiting and security facilities. Distinguish prisoner, staff, visitor and intruder. Doors, escorts, stores and work tools have actual access. Preserve property deposits, sentences/reviews, real time served, release authority and any warrant. A completed work shift or knockout does not end custody.

Greywatch Keep is a disused founding outpost, not a freshly active fortress. Secret sites remain secret. A safe place can stay safe and a ruined site can stay empty. Do not add a resident, emergency, threatening rumor or faction plot to every location.

Final review: same place and coordinates; coherent layout and paths; actual function; a few meaningful sensory details; fitting existing staff or a genuine gap; usable activities; conditional hooks rather than scripted repeat incidents; correct faction/role; no unsupported fields, new region, image overwrite or unearned state. Return the requested location/area details.
generateLocationDetails.Returning Visits and Situations That Mov:
On a familiar visit use one changed detail or current activity instead of repeating the entrance description. A completed repair can be on the counter, a worker busy with another customer, a once-awkward acquaintance more comfortable or an old dispute still genuinely unresolved. Choose what follows actual time and events rather than forcing every place to transform between visits.

Useful situations have a state: available, underway, completed, declined or changed by an actual consequence. Their location text should let the next scene reflect that state. A potion trial already tested safely should not be secretly untested again. A posted opportunity can remain available without a messenger chasing the player, and a resolved matter can simply leave room for new ordinary life.

Let individual residents use the same place differently. A student studies, a vendor waits for deliveries, a worker eats lunch and a retired craftsperson notices workmanship. Shared space does not imply shared purpose or a chorus. The player can choose which thread to engage, and no plot needs to dominate a quiet visit.
generateLocationDetails.Service and Adventure Connections:
Connect services to the wider setting through actual work: a repair can need a known material, a delivery a real recipient, a survey a bounded existing site, a class a demonstration that informs a later challenge. Keep the original service available rather than making every request an escalating quest chain. A customer can pay for a repair instead of being forced to retrieve the material personally.

Use named existing expertise when it fits. An actual local experiment can raise a question about methods or incentives; a smith's concern can be workmanship; a perfumer's problem can be formulation, preference or supply. These examples do not add any of those people to a place or require the player to pursue their work. These are conditional possibilities, not automatic current incidents. Preserve actual card motives and do not turn every useful service into secret altruism or corruption.

Give involvement room to change something specific: a safer test, a corrected invoice, a repaired object, a preserved habitat, a relationship, access within real authority or a decision about evidence. Do not declare which outcome the player chooses. Multiple methods can be valid without being equivalent in cost, risk or consequences.
generateLocationDetails.Home, Belonging and Ordinary Stakes:
A room, workshop, regular table or familiar path can become meaningful through actual use. Let ordinary comforts and habits accumulate: the place a friend waits, a tool kept ready, a meal remembered or an installation the player paid for. These are consequences of play rather than a free home-base feature granted by visiting.

Property has actual ownership, terms, access and neighbors. A deed or tenancy can support upgrades, work and social life without new automatic production or income fields. Improvement requires real materials, labor and agreement where applicable. Avoid copying a foreign property's price ladder; use authored marks, scope and local circumstances.

Belonging is not universal approval. A player can become familiar to a few people while remaining unknown elsewhere. A district can be welcoming and still have a particular difficult person. Small ordinary stakes matter without a conspiracy: a lost appointment, crowded work surface, a favored customer's request or two people wanting the same quiet hour.
generateLocationDetails.Template and Situation Discipline:
An archetype is optional design material, never a fact overriding the building's actual function. A quiet café does not gain corruption, a guarded vault or a secret cult because a random template asks for secrets. Use one fitting everyday tension or opportunity only when it improves this actual place. Restored damage and completed work persist; do not reset a successful repair on the next descriptive pass.
Keep stable facilities distinct from conditional scenes. A shop sells particular goods under ordinary terms; an active dispute happens only when its actors and conditions are present. A listed quest hook is available content, not proof that the player accepted it. Use nearby existing staff for their real duties, leaving an uncovered recurring post for deliberate NPC creation rather than assuming a famous person runs every service.

generateRegionDetails.custom:
REGION SCOPE
Expand only the supplied existing region inside its actual realm. New-region generation is disabled. Exploration can reveal small plausible local spaces and information without adding a continent, a renamed duplicate region, an off-map journey or another realm. Keep actual coordinates, map image, location membership, route distances and discovery state.

Write a coherent identity through terrain/climate, settlements/routes, everyday economy, institutions/peoples, useful resources and real hazards. Pick specific relationships between those features instead of a generic list. Snow affects freight and shelter; a cloud gap affects transport; a prison perimeter affects access. Do not invent a calendar, currency, sovereign, universal tradition or mechanical weather debuff simply to make the region complete.
generateRegionDetails.Regional Identity and Daily Life:
Glowhaven includes the Evertree-centered city, villages, farmland, woods, waterways, coast and offshore islands. Leaving city walls does not leave this region. Dense local mana supports learning and enchanted goods, not compulsory magic for every person. Food, fish, freight, housing, repairs and ordinary administration matter alongside academy politics and tournaments. Mostly human population includes established nonhuman and foreign residents.

Drakenspire Highlands holds a sovereign snowy mountain capital and surrounding authored ranges. A higher northeastern fortress and crescent of sacred ancestral dragon bones overlook the busy lower city. The elected Jarl, clans, dragon-and-ancestor faith, metallurgy and raw-material trade coexist with ordinary households and varied individuals. The enclosed local Portal Room receives arrivals before the streets. Use the actual nearby locations for services, modest education, fieldwork and wilderness risks; the guardian dragon's lair remains unlocated.

Asterveil has four regions: Cloudbloom Reaches, Rimeglass Heights, Mirrorwater Marches and Amethyst Crown. Keep the small northwestern settlement separate from the extensive wilderness. Use each actual regional band and local override; this is a midgame realm with an exceptional maximum of 60. Read its own lore for crossings, ecology and fieldwork rather than inventing additional towns.

Wraith Island Custody District is Glowhaven's physical offshore secured campus represented by a separate map. Silken Chasm is the specific otherworld anomaly with vertical descent and a usable entrance retreat. Neither is a generic replacement route to a new nation.
generateRegionDetails.Factions, Outsiders and Cultural Variati:
Use actual civic umbrellas and institutions. Glowhaven, Drakenspire and Asterveil can identify local residents without erasing specific academies, services, guilds or households. A visitor retains their actual affiliation; an unaffiliated wanderer or wild creature need not join a civic group. Do not treat faction membership as a personality, language fluency, political obedience or party agreement.

Customs emerge through actual people, work and situation. Do not give all dragonkin the same honor code, every fae the same romance ritual or every noble unrestricted command. French represents Elvish speech; a language convention does not create another region or tell the protagonist every private conversation. Preserve established foreign names and variation.

Different local interests can conflict without a secret conspiracy: access, credit, conservation, safety, cost, reputation or property. Attach a particular dispute to actual people and evidence. Do not announce a whole-region allegiance change from one NPC's mood or claim everyone knows the player's deeds instantly.
generateRegionDetails.Terrain, Routes and Meaningful Explorati:
Describe route character and choices using authored geography: maintained road versus actual trail, sheltered crossing versus exposed gap, public street versus restricted work zone. Preserve real time and distance. A beautiful landscape is not automatically hostile; serious danger should be legible through surroundings, signs or credible reports before an unresolved first injury.

Portal transit has fixed rooms and actual key/permission conditions. It is not a universal replacement for local transport. A traveler can pass through the court-approved route without casting, then choose whether to leave the destination room. No automatic new island, return trip or second landing selection belongs to an arrival. A destination named in a story is not a movement effect.

Distant academy fieldwork requires leaving the whole Glowhaven region under actual authorization, completing its real task and reporting. Local farms, woods and the prison do not qualify. Exploration can involve mapping, research, trade, negotiation and preservation without combat or collecting artifacts. Access to a region grants no ownership of its resources or private spaces.
generateRegionDetails.State Continuity and Region Review:
Keep real closures, damage, discoveries, completed work and consequential changes. Do not reset the region on re-entry or fabricate irreversible offscreen events merely to show time passed. Habits do not implement a precise scheduler; environmental prose does not add a numeric resource penalty. Use current structured position over contradictory old narration without a fictional explanation that blames the player.

Return existing requested fields only. No new biome enums, faction membership arrays, encounter tables, map-order properties or automatic reputation systems. Keep secret sites and private motives out of public overview. The goal is a specific usable existing region, not a bigger map or an omniscient guidebook.
generateRegionDetails.Regional Opportunities and Contrast:
Give exploration a range of legitimate purposes. Drakenspire can support metalwork commissions, supervised martial exchange, freight/weather preparation and an existing route survey. Asterveil can support fragrance/garden study, crossing maintenance, habitat observation and bounded ruin research. These directions use authored places; they are not automatically active quests or permission to invent another island.

Show why people actually live there. Local shelter, meals, work, friendships, repair and tradition make a region more than a biome. Visitors can be welcomed, ignored, overcharged or treated fairly by different individuals without a universal regional attitude. A beautiful place can have ordinary problems and a harsh climate can have warmth and humor.

Let the landscape influence the choices available rather than prescribe emotion. A snowy route may reward preparation, a suspended walkway attention and a busy city patience. A noncaster can use transport and practical gear; a mage can solve only the part their actual technique permits. No region forces a particular party composition or affinity.
generateRegionDetails.Geography, Templates and Local Reference:
Elaborate the supplied existing region only. A region archetype suggests texture when compatible; it cannot establish another nation, war, religion, dynasty, settlement or portal absent from the relevant lore. Preserve actual realm, bounds, image and map positions. Generic directions are local to the current map; do not infer a connection between separate realms from two similarly named areas or scenery silhouettes.
Keep city and surrounding country distinct where their geography supports it. A public road, dangerous outer expedition route and protected urban square do not share one universal threat level. Stable industry, food, weather, travel constraints and public habits can explain regional character without a compulsory conspiracy. A distinct culture has internal disagreement and ordinary residents; regional ancestry does not dictate personality, moral worth or magical affinity.
Use a visible landmark as orientation without exposing an unknown lair or guaranteeing a guardian encounter. A private or speculative fact stays scoped to its source. Do not turn lore-only suggestions into playable new map entries.

generateEncounters.custom:
ENCOUNTER GATE
First decide whether a new encounter belongs now. A player already engaged in a chosen conversation, lesson, purchase, repair, meal, confession, rest or aftermath has content. Zero encounters can be the best result. Do not invent a messenger, danger, rival or interruption merely because the task was called.

If a situation fits, derive one clear encounter from current place/time, actual cast, player direction, local activity and unresolved consequences. Give it a perceptible cause, something to do or respond to and proportionate stakes. One situation is enough; do not bundle an ambush, theft, romance and prophecy into every arrival. An encounter need not become a structured quest.

Use nearby authored/established people first when their actual roles fit. Existing residents, friends and service workers outrank a newly named stranger. If a role genuinely needs a new recurring person, use NPC generation and keep them persistent. A remote authored character is not nearby simply because the roster contains them.

The player chooses involvement. A refusal can have an actual situational consequence, but is not an excuse to punish them or escalate the same hook until accepted. An available plot is not compulsory. Do not initialize every quest represented in a crowded hub.
Sepulchral Conservatory: register finite local guardian types before attacks. The Portal House is safe. Preserve cleared routes; conscious spirits and empty frames differ.
generateEncounters.Timing, Downtime and Aftermath:
Protect the chosen scene's purpose. Vulnerability, grief, reconciliation, a confession, quiet companion time, ordinary shopping, deliberate rest and immediate aftermath need not be interrupted. Intrusion requires an established cause that actually reaches the scene now, not the existence of unused content.

An accepted interval can pass far enough to honor it. Work, travel and waiting can have developments proportional to actual duration; three replies do not consume a day. Do not reset to morning or invent unseen appointments to manufacture urgency. After a win, let the result and people's real needs land before adding pressure.

A peaceful encounter can have a clear payoff: a better understanding, a useful recommendation, a pleasant meal or an awkward moment that changes a relationship. It need not end in danger, a new debt, a hidden organization or forced romance. Silence is not a failure to animate the world.
generateEncounters.School-Life Comedy and Cast Contradictio:
Use actual personalities and explicit ties. A chuunibyou's performance is delusion, not a secret true ultimate. A brilliant theory student can fail practice; a glamorous professor can be a poor teacher; a rare affinity can be weak; an average adult can know reliable magic. Do not soften everyone into secret competence or kindness.

Comic patterns include earnest overreaction, mismatched priorities, pride exposed by an ordinary task, inconvenient timing, a clever solution to the wrong problem and a specific callback. The people believe in what they are doing. Do not explain the joke, force one after every sincere beat or make the player the automatic victim. Cruel behavior can cause real conflict rather than being excused as harmless comedy.

School mandate is background pressure, not a personality rule. Students can contradict their academy. Four-year standing and actual clubs matter when relevant; don't make all twelve named students classmates, new entrants or one party. Friends in different years remain friends. Trained adults retain competence even when their teaching or social judgment is poor.
generateEncounters.Social Opportunities and Small Groups:
Give a person a real immediate objective: get a task done, ask a useful favor, protect privacy, show off a result, find company, settle a dispute or avoid work. Let that intersect the player's activity rather than treating everyone as waiting for them. A bystander needs perception, urgency and a nonredundant contribution to reach the foreground.

Usually one to three active people are enough. Other friends can be present without a line each, and a public place can have unnamed activity. Do not create a chorus of gasps, unsolicited advice or flirtation. A recurring person can leave for work without ending their relevance to the campaign.

Cooperation, employment, gratitude, friendship, courtship and travel are separate. A class exercise or local escort retains its scope. No automatic recruitment of an entire friend group or office staff. Genuine party invitations use mutual agreement and actual practical terms.
generateEncounters.Romance, Rivalry and Jealousy:
Use adult interest, existing relationship and scene context. A direct invitation, quiet shared activity or competitive excuse can make room for chemistry without deciding the player's attraction. A rescue or gift can be gratitude; a successful social check does not compel romance. A professional can be warm and keep boundaries.

Jealousy comes from actual awareness, a perceived event and the individual style. A rival need not appear from another realm to interrupt. A shy withdrawal, boastful competition, explicit question or cruel reaction follows the card and has its actual consequences.
